Final head for L1 · area a4-U · 2026-11-25T09:01Z
Head-sha: `e13c940de4470856f564ab0db9f889e4214d2b1b`

- Render guard only, per ruling A (7118756694, the maintainer's 「保持走翻译包」). `packages/spec` is untouched and nothing is translated.
- In `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-button.tsx`, every read of `schema.label` goes through a new helper, `renderableLabel`:
  - a string is returned unchanged;
  - any other value becomes no label, so the button renders with no text, still runs, and never prints `[object Object]`.
- A dev build logs one `console.warn` per component, keyed on `data-obj-id` and then `name`, using the `process.env.NODE_ENV` pattern from `auto-trigger.ts`.
- All four reads are covered: the visible diagnostic label (~182), the label forwarded to the runner (~295), the icon spacing (~485) and the text (~486). `label` is also added to `handleClick`'s deps.
- Pins: a top-level `describe` for #36717 in the existing harness `action-button-icon-inputs-11168.test.tsx`, through the real `SchemaRenderer` and `ActionProvider`. Four tests:
  - an object label renders an empty button with no `[object Object]` and one warning across two mounts;
  - the action still runs and forwards `label: undefined`;
  - CONTROL: a string label renders;
  - CONTROL: a bundle-key translation renders 购买额度.
- Ablation: making the guard pass the label through gives 2 failed with "Objects are not valid as a React child", which is main's behaviour. The 2 controls pass. Restored to blob == HEAD.
- Readings, from the dev:
  - components action renderers 626 tests passed;
  - full components suite 4970 passed;
  - type-check exit 0;
  - 38 gate families all exit 0. The ui `scripts/` timeout on a contended box passed on re-run under the lock.
- overlap-check: clean against main and #37215. This PR's hunks avoid #37215's.
- Acceptance notes:
  - `auto-trigger.ts` still interpolates `schema.label` into a dev-only message and a toast id. It cannot throw, shows nothing to a user, and is outside the surface.
  - A non-string label on an icon-less button leaves no accessible name. That follows from the ruling's "render no text", and the warning names the bundle-key fix.
- Check-runs at this head: 45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failing or pending; `mergeable_state` clean. Size +115/-5. Not governed. No spec change, so no L2 is owed.
- Handed to the seat session for L1. This zone does not ready or queue the PR before an ACCEPT on this head.

## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `e13c940de4470856f564ab0db9f889e4214d2b1b` · 2026-11-25T09:10Z

- Verdict: REWORK on S1 below. One in-surface finding; the rest of the checklist passes.
- Ruling: within ruling A (7118756694, the maintainer's 「保持走翻译包」, recorded 2026-11-24T01:05Z). The diff is 3 files (`action-button.tsx`, the existing harness, one `patch` changeset). `packages/spec` is untouched and nothing is translated. A non-string label renders no text, which is one of the two outcomes the ruling allows ("render no text (or the component id)"), and a dev warning is logged. The ruling's pin ("renders without crashing and shows no `[object Object]`") is in the new `describe`. Not beyond the ruling.
- Zone claim 1 (render guard only): holds.
- Zone claim 2 (all 4 label reads go through `renderableLabel`): holds for the four sites it names, which are the `visible` diagnostic, the runner forward, the icon spacing and the text. It does not hold as "every read of `schema.label`" (PR body, changeset). See S1.
- Zone claim 3 (ablation and controls): reproduced at head in a throwaway worktree, which was then removed.
  - Pins at head: `-t "non-string label"` gives 4 passed, 55 skipped. The whole harness file passes 59/59.
  - Full ablation: I restored `action-button.tsx` to the merge-base `d7f299c0` blob and kept the new tests. Result: 2 failed with "Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {en, zh-CN})", which is main's crash. The 2 controls passed.
  - Partial ablation: I reverted only the runner forward to `label: schema.label`. Result: 1 failed ("the runner is handed no label") and 3 passed. So the forward site is pinned on its own.
  - After the restore, the tree was clean.
  - The dev's own ablation ran on `e8894fd`, not the final head. My re-run at `e13c940` replaces that reading.
- Information loss in `renderableLabel`:
  - A string is returned unchanged.
  - `null` and `undefined` become `undefined`, which renders the same as before.
  - An object or an array becomes `undefined`. The button text is never `[object Object]` and never a locale entry; the pin asserts that neither locale string appears.
  - Nothing a valid label can carry is lost.
- S1 (should-fix) — A fifth `schema.label` read in the same family is left unguarded. It puts `[object Object]` in front of the user, and the PR's Acceptance note describes it wrongly.
  - The site: `action-button.tsx` calls `useAutoTriggerOnce(schema, isVisible, handleClick)` with the raw `schema`.
  - `auto-trigger.ts:165` builds the user-facing refusal toast from `action.label || action.name`. A locale map is truthy, so it wins over `name`.
  - Measured at head with `action:button`, `label: { en, 'zh-CN' }`, `autoTrigger: true`, `visible: '1 == 2'` and `data-obj-id="buy_credits"`. `toast.warning` was called with `"[object Object]" is not available on the current page.` and id `auto-trigger-refused:[object Object]`. The dev console warning also read `action "[object Object]" …`.
  - This is the output the ruling's pin forbids. It makes three texts false:
    - the changeset sentence "never prints `[object Object]`";
    - the PR body's "every read of `schema.label` goes through one guard";
    - the Acceptance note's "can't throw or show anything to a user".
  - Not a regression: on main, a hidden button returns early, so this path showed the same toast.
  - It is in reach inside the card's file surface. Hand the hook a subject that carries the guarded label, e.g. a memoized `label === schema.label ? schema : { ...schema, label }`. Add a pin for the refusal toast with an object label, then correct the changeset, the body and the Acceptance note to match.
- Acceptance note — same family, out of this card's reach. The sibling page components also declare `label: z.string()` and render it raw: `action-menu.tsx:414` (`{schema.label}`), `action-group.tsx:451` (`{schema.label || 'Actions'}`) and `action-icon.tsx:314/337`. Probed at head, `action:menu` with a locale-map label throws "Objects are not valid as a React child". The ruling and the claim scope this card to `action-button.tsx`, so this is a follow-up card for the seat to file, not part of this PR. The PR's Acceptance notes do not mention it, so add a line there.
- N1 — A numeric label (e.g. `5`) rendered as text on main and is now dropped, with a warning. The contract refuses it (`z.string()`), so this follows the ruling.
- N2 — The warning key falls back to `'action:button'` when there is no `data-obj-id` and no `name`, so only the first such button warns. Minor.
- Check-runs at `e13c940`: 58 in total, 45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed or pending. Lint & Repo Gates is `success` and TypeScript Type Check is `success`. `mergeable_state` is clean. `l1-face.mjs --pr 37262` reports CLEAN (13 items, none flagged).
- K = 6: merge-base `d7f299c0` to origin/main `9171bed0`. `git merge-tree` against origin/main is clean, and main has not touched any of the 3 files since the merge-base.
- Changeset, read sentence by sentence:
  - (1) "label is a string, localized through `pages.PAGE.components.COMPONENT_ID.label`": true (`translation.zod.ts` ~1600; the bundle-key CONTROL passes).
  - (2) "used to throw … and white-screen the whole page": true (ablation).
  - (3) "renders with no text, still runs its action, never prints `[object Object]`, … one warning per component that names the bundle key": false on "never prints `[object Object]`" (S1). The rest is true.
  - (4) "The value is not translated": true.
  - (5) "A string label renders and translates exactly as before": true.
- 维护者速读, read sentence by sentence:
  - Bullet 1 (no white screen; the button shows and can be clicked with no text; one dev notice; strings unchanged): true.
  - Bullet 2 (ruling A, strings only, render guard only, no translation, no protocol change): true.
  - Bullet 3 (the worst case is a button with no text; revertable): true for what this diff changes.
  - Bullet 4 (nothing for the maintainer to do): true.
- `Clause-②: no` is right: `renderableLabel` is module-private, and there is no new export, route or spec key. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: no spec or metadata-protocol file is touched. `Fixes #36717` is right: the ruling puts only the render guard on this card and moves the cloud billing work to a `repo:cloud` card. No closing keyword sits next to another card number.
- Changeset coverage: `@object-ui/components` is published (no `private`), and it has a `patch` entry.
- Overlap: among the open PRs, only #37215 (head `7a6b50db`) touches `action-button.tsx`. Its hunks are the imports (~21) and an early return (~432). `git merge-tree` of `e13c940` against #37215's head is clean. No open PR touches `auto-trigger.ts` or the harness file.
- Rework: same claim, a patch round back to the original dev for S1 and the Acceptance note line. After that, re-L1 the new head.

Final head for the delta read (rework round 1) · area a4-U · 2026-11-25T12:57Z
Head-sha: `fce37f7f1c7dfc40470eef155ecc3ff5f5251d10`

Against REWORK 7157997155. Dev report: 7162989235.

- **S1, fixed:** `action-button.tsx` now hands `useAutoTriggerOnce` a guarded subject. `autoTriggerSubject` is a `React.useMemo` of `label === schema.label ? schema : { ...schema, label }`. The refusal toast, its id and the dev warning therefore never carry `[object Object]`; they name the action by `name`. All five label reads now go through `renderableLabel`.
- **New pin** in the #36717 describe, "an object label never reaches the auto-trigger refusal notice". It mounts with `autoTrigger: true`, `visible: false` and a locale-map label, and asserts:
  - exactly one `toast.warning`;
  - neither the message nor the id carries `[object Object]`;
  - the message names `probe_action`;
  - no console warning carries it;
  - the action never runs.
- **CI red at `da40a35c`:** a mounting error, not timing. The pin first mounted through `SchemaRenderer`, whose node gate hides a `visible: false` node before the renderer mounts, so the hook never ran; it failed the same way locally. The pin now mounts the registered renderer directly, which is the path `action:bar` takes.
- **Ablation at `fce37f7f`:** restoring `useAutoTriggerOnce(schema, isVisible, handleClick)` makes the new pin fail with `"[object Object]" is not available on…` (1 failed, 4 passed). It was restored to blob == HEAD.
- **N1:** a numeric label is now dropped. This is stated in Acceptance notes, in 速读 bullet 3 and in the changeset.
- **Acceptance notes:** they cite #37266 (`action:menu`/`group`/`icon`), and the old auto-trigger note is removed. The body was rewritten from the dev's file; read-back identical, signed trailer last.
- **Readings, from the dev:**
  - harness 60 of 60;
  - `components` action renderers 37 files and 619 tests, with type-check exit 0;
  - 37 of 38 dispatch-gates families exit 0 this round.

  `vitest run scripts/` was not re-run, because the diff does not touch `scripts/`; that is round 1's reading. The dev's `--ran` line for it is wrong and is disregarded.
- **NOT MEASURED:** the CI log's "Expected `onClick` listener to be a function, instead got a value of `string` type" warning does not reproduce locally and is not attributed to this diff.
- **K:** 6, so no main merge.
- **Check-runs at this head:** 47 success, 15 skipped, 0 failing or pending.

Handed to the seat session for the delta read.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `fce37f7f1c7dfc40470eef155ecc3ff5f5251d10` · 2026-11-25T13:05Z

- Verdict: ACCEPT. This is a delta read against REWORK 7157997155 at `e13c940`, and it follows the zone's final comment 7163103112. The delta is 2 commits (`da40a35`, `fce37f7`) in the same 3 files: `action-button.tsx` (+9/−1), the harness (+32) and the changeset (one paragraph). The ruling is unchanged: ruling A (7118756694), still render guard only. `packages/spec` is untouched and nothing is translated.
- S1 is closed. `action-button.tsx:191-194` builds `autoTriggerSubject = useMemo(() => label === schema.label ? schema : { ...schema, label }, [schema, label])`, and `:464` hands it to `useAutoTriggerOnce`.
  - In `auto-trigger.ts`, the refusal message (`action.label || action.name`), the toast id (`action.name ?? action.label`) and the dev warning (`action.name ?? action.label`) now all read the guarded label.
  - A string label keeps the same `schema` identity, so the hook's inputs are unchanged on the valid path.
- The new pin is red without the guard and green with it. I reproduced both in a throwaway worktree at `fce37f7f`, after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a turbo build of spec, formula and sdui-parser. The worktree has since been removed.
  - At head: `-t "non-string label"` gives 5 passed, 55 skipped. The whole harness gives 60/60. `packages/components/src/renderers/action/` gives 37 files and 619 tests, all passed, which matches the dev's round-2 reading.
  - Ablation: I put back `useAutoTriggerOnce(schema, isVisible, handleClick)` (anchor 1→0, blob `60bb1f19`→`426c3814`). Only the new pin failed (1 failed, 4 passed, 55 skipped), with `expected '"[object Object]" is not available on…' not to contain '[object Object]'`. After the restore, the blob is back to `60bb1f19` and the tree is clean. This matches the PR body's numbers.
- Mounting the renderer directly is the real path, not a stub.
  - The pin mounts `ComponentRegistry.get('action:button')`, which is the module's own `ActionButtonRenderer` (registered at `action-button.tsx:533`).
  - The file has no `vi.mock`/`vi.doMock`. The real `useAutoTriggerOnce`, `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate`, `useCondition` and the `ui/sonner` toast all run. The spy sits on the same `../../../ui/sonner` module that `auto-trigger.ts` imports from.
  - The ablation failing on exactly the toast assertion proves the hook was reached.
  - The "path `action:bar` takes" claim holds: `action-bar.tsx:307/315` mounts members through `ComponentRegistry.get(componentType)`, without `SchemaRenderer`.
  - The `da40a35` red explanation holds too. The node gate in `SchemaRenderer` hides a `visible:false` node, so going through `mount()` could never reach the hook.
- N1 (numeric label) is disclosed in three places: Acceptance notes bullet 1, 速读 bullet 3 (「以前写成数字的按钮文字会照样显示，现在同样不显示并提示一次」), and a changeset sentence. The prior N2 (the fallback warn key `action:button`) is also disclosed in Acceptance notes.
- The Acceptance notes cite #37266, which is open: "action:menu / action:group / action:icon render a non-string label raw (action:menu throws on a locale map)". The old auto-trigger note was removed, which is correct now that the read is guarded.
- Texts, read sentence by sentence against head:
  - Changeset: the sentences on the white-screen cause, "no text and still runs its action", "one warning per component that names the bundle key", the numeric label, "not translated" and "a string label … exactly as before" are all true.
  - "Every read of the label goes through the same guard, including the auto-trigger refusal notice, so `[object Object]` is never shown" is true for everything a user can see. It misses one dev-console read; see N1 below.
  - PR body: "covers all five label reads in the file" is true. The five reads are the `visible` diagnostic, the runner forward, the icon spacing, the text and the auto-trigger subject. The broader "every read of `schema.label` … nothing prints `[object Object]`" has the same dev-console exception (N1).
  - 维护者速读 bullets 1–4 (no white screen, the button shows and can be clicked with no text, ruling A with render guard only, the worst case is a button with no text and the numeric change is disclosed, nothing for the maintainer to do) are all true.
  - `Fixes #36717`, `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are unchanged and still right.
- N1 — There is a sixth, dev-console-only `schema.label` read in `handleClick`: `readStaticParamValues(schema, 'action:button')`. Its node-level-params warning prints `String(subject.name ?? subject.label ?? '(unnamed)')` (`static-params.ts:71`).
  - I measured it at head with a temporary probe, since removed: a nameless `action:button` with `label: { en, 'zh-CN' }` and an object node-level `params`, pressed once. The console showed `[action:button] action "[object Object]" carries an OBJECT under node-level \`params\`; it is ignored.`
  - Reaching it takes three contract violations together: no `name`, an object `params` and a non-string label. It is never user-facing, and on main the same input white-screens before anyone can click. So it does not block this PR.
  - If the PR is touched again, either pass the guarded subject (`readStaticParamValues(autoTriggerSubject, 'action:button')`) or narrow the changeset and body wording to "never shown to the user".
- Check-runs at `fce37f7f`: 62 in total, 47 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed or pending.
  - Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test UI (16/16 shards), Lint UI and Type Check UI are all success.
  - `mergeable_state` is clean. The PR is still a draft, so it has to be marked ready before it can be queued.
- Merge-tree and K:
  - `git merge-tree` of `fce37f7f` against current origin/main `e845656d` is clean (tree `93f39d78`). The harness at that merged tree is 60/60. Main has not touched `renderers/action/` or the changeset path since the merge-base `d7f299c0`.
  - The zone's "K = 6" is the round-1 figure, measured from `d7f299c0` to `9171bed0`. `landing-k.mjs --pr 37262` returns CAN'T ANSWER, because Test Core did not run in run 45613481236, so no `Affected-set diff base` was printed.
  - That run checked out `Merge fce37f7 into 4ed453dc`. From `4ed453dc`, first-parent K is 4.
  - From the merge-base `d7f299c0` it is 23.
  - Among the commits after `4ed453dc`, #37230 puts Changesets into pre mode (`next`) and retires 18.6.0 i18n keys. `actions.notAvailableHere` is kept, and a `patch` changeset is still valid under pre mode.
  - This is not a label PR, because it adds no display string.
- Overlap:
  - #37215 (head `8c569968`) touches `action-button.tsx` at the `useDrawsAction` import and a new `if (!drawsAction(schema)) return null` after the `visible` early return. Its hunks are disjoint from this PR's, and `git merge-tree` against it is clean. Semantically, the new gate sits after `useAutoTriggerOnce` and reads no label.
  - #37291 (head `db7b2e23`, 26 files) shares no file with this PR, and `git merge-tree` is clean.
- Landing: the zone lands it after measuring K; if K ≥ 15 it merges main first; a merge-only head move keeps this ACCEPT.

No must-fix, no should-fix.
